responsibility: Implements the Windows NT C-family hook controlling which entry-point identifiers are implicitly treated as extern "C" in C++ mode. It recognizes names such as WinMain, wWinMain, wmain, and DllMain so GCC uses the unmangled linkage expected by the Windows runtime without requiring explicit user declarations. This file is a narrow Win32 C++ linkage-policy override, not the general Windows target configuration.
